pages.scope: Unnumbered Kodaira theorem stated; toric special case phi=id; N generated by n,n-prime, rays n and -n+a n-prime, covering sublattice generated by the two rays, lambda-cocharacter n-prime action and Hopf quotient. Marginal original-page marker 143 begins on this page.

Hopf fundamental group Z plus Z/a; enlarged lattice N plus Z ell, shear ell -> ell+n-prime, explicit infinite cone fan and projection to affine line. Marginal original-page marker 144 occurs on this page.
Free properly discontinuous shear action; quotient family over unit disc, central self-glued ruled surface and noncentral Hopf fibres. Complete displayed diagram and conclusion read.
Theorem15.1: quadratic-field lattice, totally positive unit, quotient surface and its two cycles; hypotheses and complete statement read.
The paragraph after Theorem15.1 and the complement description: the complement of the two cycles is the product of the real line with the Clifford-torus mapping torus. Full following paragraph read.

receiving_map: For v1=n and v2=-n+a n-prime, a n-prime=v1+v2. The base change lambda=t^a lifts the n-prime cocharacter to simultaneous multiplication by t on the two ray coordinates. This is the exact map used by the receiving comparison; the primary gives the lattice/ray inputs and toric quotient family.
